text: This is Explore: films, series and creator work, chosen for what you can learn from them.
Explore all lays the whole library out on one canvas. Drag anywhere to wander.
Or switch to the timeline, and move through film history.
Search by style. Documentary finds ten titles.
Add a name, and Coodie and Chike's films come straight up.
Every title opens like a project: the trailer, what to study, and who made it.
Its press kit gathers the trailers, interviews and coverage in one place.
On the timeline, Jeen-Yuhs sits among everything else made in those years.
When something inspires you, add it to a project as a reference.
